description: Helps you decide whether you are selling to the customers you meant to. You give your current customer base, your ideal customer profile and, if you have them, current and target metrics. You get what the ideal profile has that the current base lacks, metric gaps from your own figures, causes to check and actions that fit your business model, with sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of icp_evolution_tracker when you need to compare the current customer base with a stated ideal profile.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

current_customers.description: Description of your current customer base. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

current_metrics.description: Current performance metrics. Format is a JSON object. For example, {"avg_acv":24000,"avg_sales_cycle":12,"win_rate":30}.

avg_acv.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 24000.

avg_sales_cycle.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

churn_rate.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 30.

nps.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

win_rate.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 30.

ideal_icp.description: Description of your ideal customer profile. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell, used for sector notes. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

target_metrics.description: Target performance metrics. Format is a JSON object. For example, {"avg_acv":24000,"avg_sales_cycle":12,"win_rate":30}.

avg_acv.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 24000.

avg_sales_cycle.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

churn_rate.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 30.

nps.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 12.

win_rate.description: Format is a JSON number. For example, 30.
